issues.title: Missing Concurrency Control for Dynamic DB Provisioning
issues.why: The Go implementation uses a global mutex for GetOrCreateDb, but does not address file-level race conditions or WAL-mode initialization safety when multiple processes/threads attempt to create the same physical SQLite file simultaneously.
issues.fix: Implement a file-based flock or a named-mutex pattern during the physical file creation and PRAGMA initialization phase.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'EntityId' and 'Slug' Mapping
issues.why: The spec uses 'EntityId', 'Slug', and 'Entity-Slug' interchangeably across tables and file paths without defining if they are identical or how to handle collisions (e.g., 'readme.md' vs 'readme-md').
issues.fix: Explicitly define that EntityId MUST be the sanitized output of the GenerateSlug() function and enforce this in the schema constraints.

issues.title: Incomplete Acceptance Criteria for Reset TTL
issues.why: While the 5-minute TTL is mentioned, there is no GWT (Given-When-Then) test case verifying the 'expired' state transition or the cleanup of the physical files upon confirmation.
issues.fix: Add an AC in 97-acceptance-criteria.md: 'Given a reset request older than 5 mins, When confirm is called, Then return 410 Gone and do not delete files'.
